title: How Long Will I Love You

cues.en: How long will I love you?
cues.text: How long will I love you?

cues.en: As long as stars are above you,
cues.zh: 只要繁星還在你的頭頂閃爍，
cues.text: As long as stars are above you,

cues.zh: 如果可以，我會愛得更久。

cues.en: How long will I need you?
cues.text: How long will I need you?

cues.en: As long as the seasons need to,
cues.zh: 就像四季更迭需要彼此，
cues.text: As long as the seasons need to,

cues.en: How long will I be with you?
cues.text: How long will I be with you?

cues.en: As long as the sea is bound to,
cues.zh: 就像大海註定要與岸邊相擁，
cues.text: As long as the sea is bound to,

cues.en: How long will I want you?
cues.text: How long will I want you?

cues.en: As long as you want me to,
cues.text: As long as you want me to,

cues.en: How long will I hold you?
cues.text: How long will I hold you?

cues.en: As long as your father told you,
cues.zh: 就像你父親曾告訴你的，
cues.text: As long as your father told you,

cues.en: How long will I give to you?
cues.text: How long will I give to you?

cues.en: As long as I live through you,
cues.text: As long as I live through you,

en: How long will I love you?
As long as stars are above you,
How long will I need you?
As long as the seasons need to,
How long will I be with you?
As long as the sea is bound to,
How long will I want you?
As long as you want me to,
How long will I hold you?
As long as your father told you,
How long will I give to you?
As long as I live through you,
cn: 只要繁星還在你的頭頂閃爍，
如果可以，我會愛得更久。
就像四季更迭需要彼此，
就像大海註定要與岸邊相擁，
